_comment: Localizable prompt templates + NPC pretext lines for the micro-challenge library. Keyed by toolId. `{w}`/`{n}` are substituted at runtime. Localize the `en` block per language; the runner falls back to `en`.

en.word-scramble: My market words got all scrambled — help me sort one out?
en.read-aloud: I lost my spectacles. Will you read this sign aloud for me?
en.listen-choose-pic: My ears are old. Tell me which word I'm saying.
en.picture-match: These labels fell off my crates. Match them back for me?
en.fast-translate: Quick, the bell's about to ring — say what this means!
en.fill-the-blank: A moth ate a word out of my note. Which fits the gap?
en.build-sentence: My phrase fell apart on the cobbles. Put it back in order?
en.number-drill: I can't hear the prices over the crowd — what number is it?
en.odd-one-out: One of these doesn't belong on my shelf. Spot it?
en.memory-pairs: I shuffled my flash-cards. Find the matching pairs?
en.say-it-back: Repeat after me, traveler, and I'll mark my ledger.
en.dialogue-fill: I forgot my line in this little chat. What should I say?
en.category-sort: Sort my goods into the right baskets before market opens?
en.spot-typo: The printer made a mistake on my sign. Which word is wrong?
en.conjugation-tap: Help me speak properly — pick the right form of the verb?
en.rhyme-match: I love a good rhyme. Match the words that sing together?
en.countdown-recall: Remember my list — I'll test you before the bell!
en.true-false: Tell me true or false: does this translation match?
en.word-search: My words are hidden in this grid. Can you find them?
en.tap-translation: Tap every tile that means this word — sharp eyes win coins!
